newsitem.title: GREECE: ANDRIANOPOULOS CALL FOR THE FORMATION OF NEW PARTY.
newsitem.headline: ANDRIANOPOULOS CALL FOR THE FORMATION OF NEW PARTY.

text.p: Former conservative industry minister Andreas Andrianopoulos called on Greeks to join him in forming a new political party, saying the main conservative New Democracy party was obsolete.
He said the re-election of Miltiades Evert, defeated in national elections last week, to the presidency of New Democracy signalled the start of a breakup. --Stephen Weeks, Athens Newsroom, 33-11-813
